tables.name: Reason for Visit
tables.description: Rolled for each notable visitor: why they are in the capital.

results.name: Escape
results.description: They are trying to get away from something.

results.name: Diplomacy
results.description: They are here to negotiate some kind of agreement.

results.name: Looking for Fun
results.description: They came here to enjoy themselves.

results.name: An Important Meeting
results.description: They are here for a critical meeting with an individual or group.

results.name: Grudge
results.description: They are here looking to settle a score.

results.name: Tricked
results.description: They wound up here after being deceived.

results.name: Visiting an Old Friend
results.description: They are in the capital to meet with someone they haven’t seen in a long time.

results.name: In Need of Help
results.description: They are beset by a problem and have come here looking for aid.

results.name: Lost
results.description: They wound up here trying to find their way somewhere else.

results.name: Took Wrong Transportation
results.description: They wound up here thinking they were traveling to another location. They’re now lost.

results.name: Angry
results.description: They’re upset about something, and are looking to deal with it.

results.name: Interesting Place
results.description: Word of a noteworthy place reached them, and they mean to see it.

results.name: Seeking Advice
results.description: They are here to gain understanding about an issue that has been affecting them.

results.name: Following Prophecy
results.description: They are here because they feel they were meant to be.

results.name: Had a Vision
results.description: They saw something in a dream that involved coming here.

results.name: Lost a Bet
results.description: The visitor is here for some particular, unpleasant reason as the losing penalty of a wager.

results.name: Doing a Favor
results.description: A friend or loved one asked them to come here and resolve some kind of business.

results.name: Collecting a Debt
results.description: Someone owes the visitor (or someone connected to them), and it’s time to collect.

results.name: Looking for a Change
results.description: They are here because they want to change something significant in their life.

results.name: On the Hunt
results.description: They are in pursuit of someone or something.
